main.s02-welcome: Welcome. <break time="400ms"/> In the next two minutes, we'll walk through your Push Patch, step by step. <break time="350ms"/> Set aside about ten minutes, somewhere clean and well lit.
main.s03-kit: Here's what's in your kit: <break time="350ms"/> the amber vial with your blend, <break time="250ms"/> a sterile water dropper, <break time="250ms"/> the patch itself, <break time="250ms"/> an alcohol pad, <break time="250ms"/> a skin-prep wipe, <break time="250ms"/> and a microneedling roller.
main.s05-water: First, the most important detail. <break time="400ms"/> Your sterile water dropper holds about three and a half milliliters, <break time="200ms"/> and you only need one and a half. <break time="400ms"/> The markings are faint, so it helps to mark two lines with a marker: <break time="250ms"/> the full line, <break time="200ms"/> and the two-milliliter line. <break time="450ms"/> Remove the tip, <break time="200ms"/> then slowly squeeze the water into the amber vial, <break time="200ms"/> from the full line down to the two-milliliter line. <break time="400ms"/> That's one and a half milliliters. <break time="300ms"/> The rest of the water isn't used.
main.s06-mix: Cap the vial and mix gently, <break time="200ms"/> tipping it back and forth until the powder is fully dissolved. <break time="400ms"/> Don't shake it. <break time="300ms"/> These are delicate molecules. <break time="300ms"/> It mixes in seconds.
main.s08-load: Lay the patch flat with the white pad facing up. <break time="400ms"/> Slowly drip your mixed blend onto the center of the pad. <break time="350ms"/> Go slowly so nothing runs off the edge. <break time="300ms"/> You want it all concentrated on the pad. <break time="400ms"/> Some blends turn the pad blue. <break time="250ms"/> That's normal.
main.s10-skin: Choose a clean, flat, hair-free area that doesn't cross a joint, <break time="200ms"/> so movement won't loosen the patch. <break time="400ms"/> For most people, the easiest place to apply it yourself is the back of the upper arm, <break time="200ms"/> below the shoulder and above the elbow. <break time="450ms"/> Wipe the area with the alcohol pad and let it dry. <break time="400ms"/> Then roll the microneedling roller gently over an area just big enough for the pad to cover. <break time="400ms"/> Mild redness is normal. <break time="300ms"/> Don't roll over moles, cuts or irritated skin. <break time="400ms"/> Finish with the skin-prep wipe so the patch seals well.
main.s12-apply: Peel the backing and place the pad right over the area you prepared. <break time="400ms"/> Press the edges down all the way around, so it's fully sealed. <break time="400ms"/> Then pull the clear tab all the way out. <break time="300ms"/> That starts your patch.
main.s14-wear: Wear your patch for twelve hours. <break time="400ms"/> To take it off, wet it with warm, soapy water and peel slowly. <break time="250ms"/> Never pull it off dry. <break time="400ms"/> Wait at least a day before using the same spot again. <break time="400ms"/> One patch, once a week, for six weeks.
main.s15-good: Store your kit somewhere cool and dry, below seventy-seven degrees. <break time="400ms"/> If your skin stays irritated, or anything doesn't seem right, <break time="200ms"/> take the patch off and reach out to us.
main.s16-end: Questions? <break time="250ms"/> We're here. <break time="350ms"/> Email support at my four M life dot com. <break time="400ms"/> Reordering is one click from the link in your email.

short.t1-title: Your Push Patch in five steps.
short.t2-water: One: <break time="200ms"/> squeeze the water from the full line down to the two-milliliter line. <break time="250ms"/> That's one and a half milliliters. <break time="200ms"/> Mix gently.
short.t3-drip: Two: <break time="200ms"/> drip it slowly onto the center of the pad.
short.t4-skin: Three: <break time="200ms"/> clean the skin, roll gently, and wipe with the skin prep.
short.t5-seal: Four: <break time="200ms"/> apply, seal every edge, pull the tab.
short.t6-end: Five: <break time="200ms"/> wear it twelve hours. <break time="350ms"/> Questions? <break time="200ms"/> support at my four M life dot com.
